# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Subject System & 24 Overlord Deep Interactions (Slot 69, oe_sub_). Generated by gen_subject_interactions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Promote to Imperial Brother-Kingdom (敕封共主兄弟王国)
oe_sub_promote_to_brother_kingdom = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
        any_subject = { country_type = location num_locations >= 12 }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            prestige >= 15
            legitimacy >= 20
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_brother_kingdom }
            NOT = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
            subject_type_is_not_locked = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_promote_bro_cd } }
            num_locations >= 12
            religion = scope:actor.religion
            subject_loyalty >= 55
            liberty_desire < 50
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_prestige = -15
                add_legitimacy = -10
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_sub_brother_kingdom
                add_liberty_desire = -25
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_promoted_brother }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_promote_bro_cd years = 20 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -40
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    num_locations >= 16
                    liberty_desire >= 30
                }
            }
            add = 65
        }
    }
}

# 2. Convert to Imperial Foederati (改立同盟边藩)
oe_sub_convert_to_foederati = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        OR = {
            has_or_had_tag = BYZ
            has_or_had_tag = ROM
            has_or_had_tag = RUS
            has_or_had_tag = MOS
            country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
        }
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            OR = {
                has_or_had_tag = BYZ
                has_or_had_tag = ROM
                has_or_had_tag = RUS
                has_or_had_tag = MOS
                country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
            }
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 100
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_foederati }
            NOT = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
            subject_type_is_not_locked = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_foederati_cd } }
            subject_loyalty >= 50
            liberty_desire < 50
            any_neighbor_country = {
                NOT = { this = scope:actor }
                NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -100
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_sub_foederati
                add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = 12 }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_foederati_muster years = 10 mode = replace }
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_foederati_pact }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_foederati_cd years = 15 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 350 }
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    is_subject_type = vassal
                    any_neighbor_country = {
                        OR = { is_rival_of = scope:actor is_enemy_of = scope:actor }
                    }
                }
            }
            add = 55
        }
    }
}

# 3. Charter Commercial Free City (敕许商业特许城邦)
oe_sub_charter_free_port = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        country_rank_level >= 3
        any_subject = { country_type = location has_ports = yes num_locations <= 8 }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            country_rank_level >= 3
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 150
            prestige >= 5
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_charter_city }
            NOT = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
            subject_type_is_not_locked = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_charter_cd } }
            has_ports = yes
            num_locations <= 8
            subject_loyalty >= 50
            liberty_desire < 50
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -150
                add_prestige = -5
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_sub_charter_city
                change_government_type = government_type:republic
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_charter_port }
                reverse_add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_charter_port }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_charter_cd years = 15 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -40
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 500 }
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    is_subject_type = vassal
                    num_locations <= 4
                    has_ports = yes
                }
            }
            add = 55
        }
    }
}

# 6. Transfer Border Fortress (划转边城要塞防务) — Player tactical micro only
oe_sub_transfer_border_fortress = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = never
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            num_locations > 1
            at_war = no
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_transfer_fort_cd } }
            at_war = no
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        source = actor
        source_flags = only_actual_locations
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_sub_select_fort_to_transfer"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_border_fort"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        visible = {
            is_capital = no
            has_fort = yes
            any_coast_border_location = {
                has_owner = yes
                owner ?= scope:recipient
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            scope:actor = { oe_sub_bump_act = yes }
            scope:target = {
                change_location_owner = scope:recipient
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_bastion_loc years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_liberty_desire = -15
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_fort_granted }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_transfer_fort_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
}

        default_sort = will

        visible = {
            country_type = location
            num_locations > 1
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_req_fort_cd } }
            subject_loyalty >= 55
            liberty_desire < 45
            at_war = no
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        source = recipient
        source_flags = only_actual_locations
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_sub_select_fort_to_requisition"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_subject_fort"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        visible = {
            is_capital = no
            has_fort = yes
            any_coast_border_location = {
                has_owner = yes
                owner ?= scope:actor
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -250
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:target = {
                change_location_owner = scope:actor
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_gold = 150
                add_liberty_desire = 20
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_fort_comp_tax years = 5 mode = replace }
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_fort_requisitioned }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_req_fort_cd years = 15 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# 8. Levy Subject Naval Squadron (征调附庸海军舰队)
oe_sub_levy_subject_fleet = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 12
    ai_prerequisite = {
        has_ports = yes
        at_war = yes
        any_subject = { has_ports = yes }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            has_ports = yes
            any_subject = { has_ports = yes }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { prestige >= 5 }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            has_ports = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_levy_fleet_cd } }
            subject_loyalty >= 55
            liberty_desire < 50
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_prestige = -5
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_requisitioned_fleet years = 5 mode = replace }
                add_sailors = { value = scope:recipient.monthly_sailors multiply = 6 }
                oe_sub_spawn_levied_ships = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:recipient = { num_locations >= 8 } }
                    oe_sub_spawn_bonus_ship = yes
                }
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_liberty_desire = 10
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_levy_fleet_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -40
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { at_war = yes prestige >= 20 }
                scope:recipient ?= { liberty_desire < 35 }
            }
            add = 60
        }
    }
}

# 9. Arbitrate Vassal Feud (帝国御前仲裁附庸私斗)
oe_sub_arbitrate_subject_feud = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 12
    ai_prerequisite = {
        any_subject = { count >= 2 }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = { count >= 2 }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            gold >= 50
            political_influence >= 5
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            oe_sub_has_feud_target = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_arbitrate_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -50
                add_political_influence = -5
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { any_subject = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_at_war_with = scope:recipient } }
                    random_subject = {
                        limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
                        save_scope_as = oe_sub_feud_other
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { any_subject = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_rival_of = scope:recipient } }
                    random_subject = {
                        limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
                        save_scope_as = oe_sub_feud_other
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    random_subject = {
                        limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } opinion = { target = scope:recipient value < 0 } }
                        save_scope_as = oe_sub_feud_other
                    }
                }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_arbitrate_cd years = 5 }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_feud_other }
                    if = {
                        limit = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_sub_feud_other }
                        leave_all_wars_with = scope:oe_sub_feud_other
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { is_rival_of = scope:oe_sub_feud_other }
                        remove_rival = scope:oe_sub_feud_other
                    }
                    add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_sub_feud_other years = 5 mutual = yes }
                }
            }
            scope:actor = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_arb_a value = scope:recipient }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_feud_other }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_sub_arb_b value = scope:oe_sub_feud_other }
                }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.30
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -10
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    scope:actor = { any_subject = { NOT = { this = prev } is_at_war_with = prev } }
                }
            }
            add = 80
        }
    }
}

# 11. Levy Extraordinary War Tribute (加征军兴特别岁币)
oe_sub_levy_war_extra_tribute = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 12
    ai_prerequisite = {
        at_war = yes
        gold < 120
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            OR = {
                at_war = yes
                stability >= 10
            }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_war_trib_cd } }
            OR = {
                scope:actor = { at_war = yes }
                subject_loyalty >= 60
            }
            liberty_desire < 60
            monthly_income_trade_and_tax > 0
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = { value = scope:recipient.oe_sub_war_tribute_amt }
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_gold = { value = oe_sub_war_tribute_neg }
                add_liberty_desire = 18
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_war_tribute }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_heavy_war_tribute years = 5 mode = replace }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_war_trib_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -55
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { at_war = yes gold < 100 }
                scope:recipient ?= { liberty_desire < 30 }
            }
            add = 70
        }
    }
}

# 12. Dispatch Imperial Engineers (派遣帝国工兵团援建)
oe_sub_dispatch_imperial_engineers = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        at_war = no
        gold >= 700
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 200
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_engineers_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -200
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_engineers years = 10 mode = replace }
                capital ?= {
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_engineers_loc years = 10 mode = replace }
                }
                ordered_owned_location = {
                    limit = { is_capital = no }
                    order_by = population
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    max = 1
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_engineers_loc years = 10 mode = replace }
                }
                add_liberty_desire = -10
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_engineers_sent }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_engineers_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no gold >= 900 } }
            add = 45
        }
    }
}

# 13. Send Imperial Military Drill Mission (派遣教导团军制整训)
oe_sub_military_drill_mission = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        gold >= 400
        army_tradition >= 15
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            gold >= 150
            army_tradition >= 15
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_drill_cd } }
            subject_loyalty >= 50
            liberty_desire < 50
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -150
                add_army_tradition = 2
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_drill years = 10 mode = replace }
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_drill_mission }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_drill_cd years = 12 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 500 }
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    OR = {
                        is_subject_type = oe_sub_foederati
                        is_subject_type = march
                        is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu
                    }
                }
            }
            add = 50
        }
    }
}

# 14. Codify Shared Commercial Law (颁行帝国统一商法与度量衡)
oe_sub_codify_shared_law = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        at_war = no
        gold >= 300
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 80
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_shared_law_cd } }
            subject_loyalty >= 60
            liberty_desire < 45
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -80
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_shared_commercial_code years = 15 mode = replace }
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_shared_commercial_code years = 15 mode = replace }
                add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_shared_law_cd years = 20 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -25
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 350 } }
            add = 40
        }
    }
}

# 15. Subsidize Frontier Garrisons (拨付边防常备戍饷)
oe_sub_subsidize_frontier_garrison = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    block_when_at_war = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        gold >= 400
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { gold >= 180 }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            any_neighbor_country = {
                OR = {
                    is_rival_of = scope:actor
                    is_enemy_of = scope:actor
                    is_at_war_with = scope:actor
                }
            }
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_frontier_garr_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -180
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_frontier_subsidy years = 10 mode = replace }
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_frontier_subsidy }
                add_liberty_desire = -8
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_frontier_garr_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -30
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 450 } }
            add = 45
        }
    }
}

# 16. Summon Imperial Diet of Homage (召集群藩述职宣誓效忠)
oe_sub_summon_imperial_diet_pledge = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 36
    ai_prerequisite = {
        at_war = no
        gold >= 350
        any_subject = { country_type = location }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { any_subject = { country_type = location } }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 120
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_diet_pledge_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -120
                add_legitimacy = 5
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_diet_subject value = scope:recipient }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_liberty_desire = -12
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_diet_homage }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_diet_pledge_cd years = 15 }
            }
            scope:actor = {
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.40
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { at_war = no gold >= 400 }
                scope:recipient ?= { liberty_desire >= 25 }
            }
            add = 50
        }
    }
}
